alias.en: Urine that sprays or splits in two instead of one steady stream
alias.zh: 尿流分叉或喷散，不是一条平稳的水流
alias.ms: Kencing yang memercik atau bercabang, bukan satu aliran tetap

lead.en: The urine stream divides or sprays sideways. It is often harmless, but it can also show a narrowing or blockage along the urine tube.
lead.zh: 尿流分叉或向旁边喷散。常常无大碍，但也可能提示尿道变窄或有阻塞。
lead.ms: Aliran kencing berpecah atau memercik ke tepi. Ia sering tidak berbahaya, tetapi mungkin juga tanda saluran kencing sempit atau tersumbat.

v.en: Family doctor; urologist if it stays
v.zh: 家庭医生；持续时看泌尿科医生
v.ms: Doktor keluarga; pakar urologi jika berterusan

v.en: Men with a big prostate; anyone with a narrow urine tube
v.zh: 前列腺增大的男性；尿道狭窄的人
v.ms: Lelaki dengan prostat membesar; sesiapa dengan saluran kencing sempit

v.en: Depends on the cause; a one-off split is often harmless
v.zh: 视原因而定；偶尔一次分叉常无大碍
v.ms: Bergantung pada punca; aliran bercabang sekali-sekala selalunya tidak berbahaya

c.en: Waking at night to pass urine

li.en: A few drops at the tip of the urine opening
li.zh: 尿道口末端残留的几滴尿
li.ms: Beberapa titik air kencing di hujung lubang kencing

h.zh: 出现这些情况请先看医生

li.en: Cannot pass urine at all, or a painful swollen lower belly: go to hospital now
li.zh: 完全无法排尿，或下腹胀痛：立即去医院
li.ms: Langsung tidak boleh kencing, atau perut bawah sakit dan kembung: ke hospital segera

li.en: Fever with chills together with urine problems
li.zh: 发烧发冷并有排尿问题

li.en: A stream that keeps getting weaker or slower
li.zh: 尿流越来越弱或越来越慢
li.ms: Aliran kencing yang semakin lemah atau perlahan

li.en: Pain when passing urine, or leaking after you finish
li.zh: 排尿疼痛，或排完后仍滴尿
li.ms: Sakit ketika kencing, atau menitis selepas selesai

p.en: If any apply, please see a doctor before a session.
p.zh: 如果有以上情况，请先看医生，再来做调理。
p.ms: Jika mana-mana berkenaan, sila jumpa doktor sebelum sesi.

p.en: This page is general information. Please keep taking your normal medicine and keep seeing your doctor.
p.zh: 本页只是一般性的健康资讯。请继续按时服用平常的药物，并继续看医生。
p.ms: Halaman ini ialah maklumat am. Sila terus mengambil ubat biasa anda dan terus berjumpa doktor.

h.en: More ways to look after yourself

li.en: Take your time and relax when passing urine
li.ms: Luangkan masa dan bertenang ketika kencing

li.en: If it lasts more than a few days, tell your doctor
li.zh: 如果持续几天以上，请告诉医生
li.ms: Jika berlarutan lebih beberapa hari, beritahu doktor anda

tell.en: Diabetes or less feeling in the skin
tell.zh: 糖尿病或皮肤感觉减退

refs: General information based on public health sources such as Mayo Clinic, NHS, Cleveland Clinic and NCBI StatPearls.
